profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Motivated IT professional seeking a role that combines technical support responsibilities with opportunities for software engineering training and development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Remote
positions.insights: Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint and +3 skills

positions.title: Freelance Videographer
positions.description:
Configured shots based on daily needs, weather and lighting conditions
and available equipment.
Managed pre-production tasks such as developing content plans and
overall message for 8 projects.
Set and maintained organized and detailed schedules for production.
Used DSLR and Cinema cameras to record component shots at over 11
different locations.
Led concept development, graphics, storytelling and delivery of segment
ideas.
Combined video, audio and graphics to effectively convey each story.
positions.insights: Event Videography, Video Editing and +1 skill

positions.title: Freelance Video Editor
positions.description:
Managed graphics, sound, music and color corrections for short films,
party, lifestyle, and wedding videos.
Facilitated projects and contributed to every stage of video and film
production.
Performed all aspects of post-production, including sound design,
sequence selection and compression.
Reviewed scenes to determine pacing and continuity and trimmed shots
to fit with content.
positions.insights: Video Editing, DaVinci Resolve and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed Python scripts for data collection, processing, and analysis of NNA layer performance metrics.
Implemented shell scripts to streamline the CI/CD pipeline and automate various tasks.
Leveraged AWS QuickSight for building interactive visualizations and dashboards, presenting complex data in a user-friendly manner.
Performed performance benchmarking and profiling to identify bottlenecks and areas for optimization.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to understand neural network architectures and layer implementations.
positions.insights: Cloud Development, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +5 skills

positions.title: Amazon Technical Academy Participant
positions.description:
Learning to work with programs such as Java, Hacker Rank and LeetCode
Learning the fundamentals of programming, how to define values/objects, algorithms etc. 
Collaboration with peers to review coding projects
Working with database structures and how to design/build out features
Completed tasks through the CI/CD pipeline
Working on troubleshooting and learning how to resolve bugs
Developing SDE-I career relevant skills with hands-on experience using industry tools

positions.title: Fulfillment Associate
positions.description:
Developed strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize work tasks to meet demanding production targets.
Safely operated powered lift trucks and participated in group lifts to handle heavy equipment within the warehouse environment.
positions.insights: Order Picking, Shipping & Receiving and +1 skill
